source_summary: The hsconfig skill should expose one normal path: source-manifest, research evidence rows, draft-source-documents, research-deck, prepare, operator_summary.json, and apply through the gate.
current_truth: HSConfig is pre-game config generation only. It should stay separate from HSTuner, replays, winrate analysis, and runtime log tuning.
repo_alignment: README.md, docs/operator/source-builder-workflow.md, and the hsconfig skill references now describe the same source-builder-lite path and keep operator_summary.json as the single gate.
implementation_implication: Skill docs should be short and command-oriented; deeper policy belongs in references/guide-research-policy.md and docs/operator/source-builder-workflow.md.
gaps_or_risks: If older docs keep describing manual source_documents.json as the only path, future runs may skip the manifest and drafter checks.
Too much orchestration language would make HSConfig resemble HSTuner again.
recommended_action: Keep the skill lean and sync it after every repo-side skill edit with scripts/sync_installed_skill.py.
